game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the smelter.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Problem values 15, 5; test inputs [{'a': -15, 'b': 5}, {'a': -5, 'b': 6}, {'a': 0, 'b': 7}, {'a': 15, 'b': 15}, {'a': -15, 'b': 5}].
controls: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the smelter from ember hounds in Charred Forest: keep the power_on meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: power_on drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
hint: Trace the arrows. Read input before using it; use rectangles for assignments and diamonds for decisions.
